npcs.name: Turbo-propelled Remote-controlled Gyro Bomber of Death

records.text: A remote-controlled mechanical gyro bomber, the Turbo-propelled Remote-controlled Gyro Bomber of Death is an assault construct built for combat.

Yggdras is a named beast and arena opponent at Zul'Drak's Amphitheater of Anguish. Its appearance is announced to spectators, and it attacks with Cleave and Corrode Flesh; its death triggers a Jormungar spawn.
An elite undead combatant titled Soldier of the Frozen Wastes.
An elite undead combatant titled Soldier of the Frozen Wastes.
Stinkbeard is a magnataur opponent named in the Amphitheater of Anguish challenge. He taunts his opponents, warning that he is coming for them.
An undead Soul Weaver.
Duke Singen, styled “The New Hotness,” is an elemental who speaks of a kingdom and servants. He threatens to melt his enemies’ flesh and calls his servants to action.
Orinoko Tuskbreaker is an Amphitheater of Anguish opponent who challenges land-dwellers with tusk and whisker. In a fight, he calls for someone named Whisker to assist him.
Enormos is a named beast.

Vladof the Butcher is presented as a vrykul champion from Icecrown and the final opponent at the Amphitheater of Anguish. He vows to tear challengers apart for an unnamed one true king. He calls a companion precious in one threat and a useless mongrel in another, declaring that he will kill the opponents himself.

Korrak the Bloodrager is Champion of the Winterax. He calls challengers weaklings and claims the amphitheater for the Winterax, correcting himself after first naming Snowfall. He threatens death and warns that there is no graveyard here for enemies to play their wicked games on him.

Gargoral the Water Lord is an elemental who boasts that he is the baddest and coolest. He calls his elements to his side to freeze and rule, and invokes Neptulon along with the strength of storm and sea to crush his enemies.

Erathius is an elemental who styles himself King of Dirt and boasts that no one stands higher. He calls earth-brothers and minions to assist him, presenting himself as their sire and promising to destroy mortals.

Az’Barin, Prince of the Gust, is an elemental who calls on Al’Akir to grant his enemies a cold, swift death. He boasts of bringing a gust strong enough to knock down trees and calls minions to help stop his opponents from doing as they please.
A plague-ridden undead zombie.
A level 50 undead called a Plague Zombie. Its name identifies it as a plague-afflicted zombie, but the supplied record gives no further personal identity or role.
A level 40 undead called a Plague Zombie. Its name identifies it as a plague-afflicted zombie, but the supplied record gives no further personal identity or role.
A level 30 undead called a Plague Zombie. Its name identifies it as a plague-afflicted zombie, but the supplied record gives no further personal identity or role.
A level 20 undead called a Plague Zombie. Its name identifies it as a plague-afflicted zombie, but the supplied record gives no further personal identity or role.
A level 10 undead called a Plague Zombie. Its name identifies it as a plague-afflicted zombie, but the supplied record gives no further personal identity or role.
A level 1 undead called a Plague Zombie. Its name identifies it as a plague-afflicted zombie, but the supplied record gives no further personal identity or role.
A level 5 undead called a Plague Zombie. Its name identifies it as a plague-afflicted zombie, but the supplied record gives no further personal identity or role.
A Rejuvenated Defender, recorded at level 79–80. The supplied record gives no further personal identity or role.
Fiend of Fire is a summoned elemental combat creature.
Fiend of Earth is a summoned elemental combat creature.
Fiend of Water is a summoned elemental combat creature.
Fiend of Air is a summoned elemental combat creature.
An undead Soul Weaver.
An undead creature known as an Unstoppable Abomination.
An elite undead abomination whose title presents it as an unstoppable force.
An earthen creature named for its stone state, its title framing it as elemental matter.
An icebound undead revenant that casts Avalanche in combat, a stark threat shaped by cold and falling ice.
A frozen orb, an elemental presence defined by its cold, rounded form.
A dragonkin wyrm bearing the Stormpeak name, its title joining a stormy quality with a draconic identity.
An elite undead guardian named for its association with Icecrown.
Kel’Thuzad serves a master in the Lich King’s cause, directs loyal forces and threatens interlopers who disrupt his plans.
A humanoid Stormforged Amplifier.
A Spore.
An undead Stitched Colossus can use Unstoppable Enrage when badly wounded and Massive Stomp in combat.
Willzyx is a beast known by an individual name.
Power Spark is an elemental that forms from a nearby rift, appearing as a sudden manifestation.
Vigilant Shade is undead.
Brokentoe (Mount) is a beast.
Mammoth Mount (Small) is a beast identified as a small mammoth mount.
Yggdras Worm is a beast.
Plagued Ghoul is undead.

Brann Bronzebeard is grateful for help assembling the keystone and expects great things from it. While piloting a plane, he urges his companion to fend off persistent iron dwarf attacks. He wants an introduction to King Stormheart near Frosthold, praising the king’s aid and feeling indebted to him. He speaks regretfully of the good keeper Creteus and is glad that Creteus saw his task completed.
A Stormcrest Eagle is a beast.
The Hungry Penguin is a beast.
Whisker can cast Flipper Thwack.
A Twilight Initiate is a humanoid identified as an initiate of the Twilight group.
A Burly Frost Giant is a humanoid giant.

Snorri was once a mighty warrior, and age has dulled his senses and weakened him. He remains proud and eager to join a fight, and still gets drawn into battle against Seething Revenants. He offers a brief greeting and casts Sleeping Sleep.
Brann’s Flying Machine is a passenger vehicle associated with Brann. When a passenger boards, it starts its waypoint route, making the boarding interaction the trigger for its flight.
A Frost Giant Ghost, one of the restless spirit targets in the task described by “Blowing Hodir’s Horn.”
A Frost Dwarf Ghost, one of the restless spirit targets in the task described by “Blowing Hodir’s Horn.”
A floating spirit of a frost giant.
A floating spirit of the Frostborn.
A floating spirit of the Frostborn.
Demo is an Icecrown cultist bearing the Cult of the Damned designation.
A Frostbrood Destroyer, an undead creature.
Nicole Morris is identified as a stable master. Her dialogue offers help with stabling pets and recovering lost companions.
Sigrid Iceborn's proto-drake carries a passenger and starts along a route after boarding.
A dragonkin Wyrmrest Skytalon.
The Stormcrest eagle is a beast.
A Frostborn stormrider, identified by that name among the Frostborn.
The Battlemaster of the Ring of Valor, identified by this arena title.
A Hyldsmeet bear rider, identified by that mounted-warrior role.
An Ahn'kahar guardian, identified by that protective role.
An Ahn'kahar swarmer, identified by that group role.
A controller associated by name with Jedoga.
A web wrap.
A serpent known as the Deep Twilight Serpent.
An owl known as the Sapphire Owl.

An Ebon Blade knight held as a prisoner, frustrated that his captors left him without his helmet but relieved to have his sword. He welcomes help and can fight alongside an ally briefly before returning to the Shadow Vault.

An Ebon Blade knight held as a prisoner, frustrated that his captors left him without his helmet but relieved to have his sword. He welcomes help and can fight alongside an ally briefly before returning to the Shadow Vault.

A summoned Forgotten Depths ambusher, this humanoid waits beneath the Nerubian Submerge aura and sheds it when engaged.
A summoned Stormforged ambusher, this creature appears as part of Stormforged activity.
An ethereal frostworg that ranges at random, it sprints after enemies, growls as it closes on prey, and howls to expose its target.

Stormforged Infiltrators are enemies in the Valley of Ancient Winters, identified in the Frostworg Denmother’s task as the spies to hunt. Their taunts mark them as Stormforged: one calls an opponent a “friend of the frost” before threatening death.
An Argent Skytalon is an Argent dragonkin creature.
The Icemaw Bear Mount is a bear mount.
A Risen Ally is an undead companion associated with a death knight’s pet ability.
Radulf Leder serves as the Arathi Basin battlemaster. He speaks of the Alliance’s aid to the League of Arathor against the Defilers, directing attention to the conflict within the basin.
An injured Sunreaver scout.
A humanoid Nexus Lord.
A humanoid Scion of Eternity.
An undead spectral trainee.
An injured scout of the Silver Covenant.
An Oathbound Warder, a named combatant bound to an oath.

A freed crusader who blesses allies with the strength left in them and calls for the Scourge to feel the fury of lost souls. They speak of returning to the Argent Vanguard, suggesting their place remains with the crusade despite the ordeal of captivity.
An enraged, armored hippogryph.
A defender serving Stormwind at its harbor.
A captain serving Stormwind at its harbor.

Overseer Narvir is working to complete an iron colossus and seeks the Heart of the Storm at Uldis to strengthen its weapons. He confronts an intruder trying to take the Heart and says that Valduran's death will not stop him.
Zombie Chow is an elite undead creature.

The Mobile Databank is a mechanical analyzer that patrols the Temple of Invention. It announces its analysis, reports that the temple remains intact, and notes that mechanical servants have turned against one another and attendants lie piled together. Its brief, measured reports present it as an observing diagnostic device.
Thorim is a humanoid.

King Jokkum speaks for his people and remembers the explosion that scattered Krolmir: his father cast a rune on the hammer to keep it from their enemies, and it was his final act. Jokkum says his people forgive Thorim for that dark day and that Thorim's deeds have softened their hearts. He calls their renewed bond a reforged friendship and offers Thorim something that belongs to him.
A Jotunheim proto-drake rider, identified by its mounted role rather than a personal name.
Surge of Power.

Jormuttar is the jormungar spawnmother in Hibernal Cavern. King Jokkum fears her brood will gain a foothold in his people’s region and seeks her death. He says she cannot refuse food and recommends luring her with flesh from a bear corpse, then striking while she feeds.
An Alliance guard in Wintergrasp who serves in close combat.
An Alliance guard in Wintergrasp who serves in ranged combat.
An axemaster of the Frostborn.
A Twilight Volunteer chosen for a ritual, this follower declares, “I have been chosen!” and “I give myself to the master!” Its lines convey willing self-sacrifice to the Twilight’s master.
A Taunka Ancestor, identified with the Taunka and their ancestral tradition.

Stormhoof is remembered as a Taunka hero who fought the North Wind; Chieftain Swiftspear is identified in the camp’s account as his brother. His own lines are urgent battle instructions, urging the use of the horn when the foe is weak and directing others to the temple’s center. His spear and mail were recovered from the North Wind’s followers, and the Lorehammer’s time journey lets another take his role in the battle.
Veranus is a dragonkin.
His lines present Dr. Terrible as a vengeful, theatrical antagonist: he announces his arrival in rhyme, threatens to flay an intruder, and vows revenge if he rises again.

Brann Bronzebeard is astonished to see Muradin after hearing reports that he was dead, and identifies himself as Muradin’s younger brother. He expects the news to delight Magni after a long period of bad news. Although he wishes Muradin safety, Brann refuses to abandon what he considers an extraordinary discovery to accompany him.

Yorg Stormheart, titled King of the Frostborn, speaks of memories returning and recognizes that he has brothers. He apologizes to Magn for remembering slowly and regrets watching someone turn away from what was right without intervening.

Magni Bronzebeard, Lord of Ironforge, is overjoyed to see his brother Muradin alive after years believing him dead, but fears losing him again. He asks about reports that Muradin has become a king and what he remembers of events, saying fate has turned ill in his absence. Magni must return to his own people and asks his brothers to come back safely.
Lok'lira the Crone is a humanoid.

Disembodied Jormungar are created when roaming jormungar are transformed with Arngrim's Tooth in the Valley of Ancient Winters. In the feeding quest, they are weakened before being offered to Arngrim, connecting this form to the old king's legendary hunger.
A Marauding Geist.

Arngrim the Insatiable is remembered as an old king whose hunger was legendary. Even in his frozen image, his expression suggests famished yearning; stories say he was never truly sated and would eat anything.
Lady Sylvanas Windrunner bears the title Banshee Queen.
A Runeforged Servant is a servant of Loken. It casts Ethereal Teleport.
Grimmr Hound is a summoned hostile animal.
Poisonous Mushroom is an environmental growth.
Vanguard Laborers are workers.
Burdened Vanguard Laborer is a burdened worker.

The Chieftain's Totem is the last link between a deceased chieftain and the world, and was a symbol of his authority. Xarantaur's account says it can calm the disturbed tomb of Tunka'lo's warriors; it is used to close Frostfloe Rifts and then returned to him.
A frostworg beast.
The Azure Magus is an elite dragonkin mage.
A disturbed Taunka ancestor, a humanoid figure.
The Azure Warder is an elite dragonkin warder.
An elite humanoid bearing the Mage Hunter Ascendant name.

Veranus is a proud proto-dragon who keeps her old nest and prevents younger proto-drakes from taking it over. Thorim hopes to gain control of her after the stolen eggs are placed there, though he warns that the disturbance may bring her into a rage.
Thorim addresses an unnamed female as her old master and urges her to be calm. He speaks of meeting at the Temple of Storms and says that he will have to break her in again.
Zak's Flying Machine is identified by name as a flying machine associated with Zak.
Dan's Test Void Sentry is a sentry associated with Dan and explicitly labeled as a test.
The Harnessed Icemaw Matriarch is a powerful beast carried in harness; when a passenger boards, it begins its waypoint route, serving as a mount for transport.
The Vargul Assailant is an undead attacker.
Mage Slayer (1) is an elite humanoid bearing a mage-hunting designation, identifying its combat role.
Mage Hunter Initiate (1) is an elite humanoid bearing a mage-hunting designation, identified as an initiate in that role.

Stormhoof’s Spirit is the brother of Camp Tunka’lo’s ruler, though his memory of visitors is impaired. He asks whether the North Wind still troubles his people and expresses gratitude for help given to the village.

The Darkmoon Fortune Teller can be summoned and speaks as part of the Faire, showing interest in tarot decks. She recognizes completed decks and praises the scribe’s work, while offering trade through the Faire’s skilled tradesmen.
A Steward can use Arcane Torrent and Spellbreaker in combat.
A Frostbrood Destroyer is an undead creature.
The D16 Propelled Delivery Device is a vehicle for delivery.
Ritssyn is a demon.
A Horde berserker.
An Alliance berserker.
A Horde cleric.
An Alliance cleric.
The Val'kyr Arbiter delivers judgment on Thane Illskar after his failed honorable combat, declaring him damned and calling him to rise.
The Stormforged Decimator is a mechanical Stormforged combat unit.
The Stormforged Warmonger is a humanoid Stormforged combatant.
The Frostborn Axemaster is a humanoid Frostborn combatant.
The Stormcrest Eagle is an animal associated by name with Stormcrest.
The Brewfest Kodo is a kodo associated with Brewfest.
A Horde ranger uses Shoot, Rapid Shot and Incendiary Shot in combat.
An Alliance ranger uses Shoot, Rapid Shot and Incendiary Shot in combat.
Grand Magus Telestra is a magus.
A spellcaster named Grand Magus Telestra who can use Fire Blast and Scorch in combat.
A spellcaster named Grand Magus Telestra who can use Critter and Time Stop in combat.
A spellcaster named Grand Magus Telestra who can use Ice Barb in combat.
A dragonkin bearing the Azure Enforcer title.
A dragonkin bearing the Azure Scale-Binder title.
A dragonkin called Azure Skyrazor.
An elemental called Crazed Mana-Surge.
A Crazed Mana-Wraith is an elemental that can use Arcane Missiles in combat.
A crazed mana-wyrm, an elemental.
A Chaotic Rift is an elemental that can cast Summon Arcane Wraith and Chaotic Rift Aura.
Thane Illskar the Damned is a named figure who appears when summoned. His arrival is staged with a change from a submerged stance to kneeling, followed by a shouted cry of “NOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!”

Crystalline Protectors are arcane-altered Ancients, described by a researcher as part of an ongoing metamorphosis. An Arcane Splinter taken from one is sought as evidence of what that transformation has produced; the researcher presents a further stage as a possibility.
A Crystalline Tender can use Toughen Hide and Tranquility in combat.
A training dummy serves as a practice target for attacks.
Keristrasza is a dragon held in the Nexus under Malygos’s power. Raelorasz’s account frames her captivity as an indignity she would not accept willingly.
Rivendare’s undead deathcharger.

A reanimated crusader associated with Father Gustav’s effort to free the restless souls of soldiers slain at Scourgeholme. He describes them as twisted reflections of their former selves and asks that their bones be blessed with holy water to give their spirits rest.

The Image of the North Wind declares that his power is growing and that he has long awaited complete revenge. He vows to erase Stormhoof and his kin from history and restore the lands to an unnamed rightful owner. He dismisses a tauren opponent and their ally as unable to stop him.
Jessica Redpath is a humanoid.
A Njorndar proto-drake, a formidable beast.
A Phantom Boar is a mechanical creature.
An elite undead Frostbrood Destroyer, one of the Scourge frost wyrms sent against the Vanguard's tower defenses.
Hammerhead is a named mechanical vehicle.

Godo Cloudcleaver is a named humanoid battlemaster for the Strand of the Ancients. His role is tied to that battleground and its battle-related service. He can tell a listener they are not yet strong enough to do battle and should return after gaining experience.
The Forgotten Depths Slayer is an undead combatant identified by a shared slayer role rather than an individual personal identity, associated with the Forgotten Depths.
Highlord Tirion Fordring is a humanoid.
Baron Rivendare challenges intruders and speaks of death as the true test, giving him a stark, fatalistic bearing.
Lady Blaumeux is one of the Four Horsemen. Her taunts show relish in the contest: she calls opponents out, claims the first kill and even proposes a wager.

Sir Zeliek is one of the Four Horsemen, yet his words urge intruders to flee and turn back. He says he has no choice but to obey and asks forgiveness, marking him as markedly regretful amid the encounter.
Thane Korth'azz is a named undead combatant associated with the Four Horsemen encounter.
A Frost Drake, an undead drake.
Bloodsting is identified as Molog's pet, a level-71 beast.
Dan's Test Dummy (Non Vehicle) is identified as a non-vehicle test dummy.
Flame Tsunami
A humanoid.
A humanoid Wintergrasp peon.
A humanoid known as Twisted Visage.
A humanoid known as Twisted Visage.
A humanoid known as Twisted Visage.
A humanoid known as Twisted Visage.
Twisted Visage is a humanoid clone summoned by Herald Volazj during Insanity; it enters combat with another selected player.
A peasant in Wintergrasp.
Known as the Eye of Acherus (DK).
Mortal Essence is an undead creature.
A Water Terror, an elemental.
A Ruby Flower.
A humanoid mason associated with the Argent designation.
Lava Blaze is an elemental creature.
The Water Terror is an elemental creature that the Bone Witch teaches a player to possess briefly and use against vrykul in Jotunheim.
Fire Cyclone is a fire-themed elemental creature.
A Portal Guardian is a powerful combatant assigned to guard a portal. Its attacks include Agonizing Strike and Side Swipe.
An Azure Invader is a hostile combatant identified with the invading force.
An Azure Spellbreaker is a hostile combatant.
An Azure Binder is a hostile combatant.
An Azure Mage Slayer is a hostile combatant identified by its role as a mage hunter.
A Veteran Mage Hunter is an experienced combatant. Its out-of-combat behavior includes casting Destroy Door Seal in a dungeon, connecting it to efforts against the seal.
An Azure Captain is a hostile combatant designated as a captain.
Azure Sorceror is a sorceror identified by that title.
Azure Raider is a raider identified by that title.
Crusader of Virtue is a crusader.
Jonna Robertson is a directions guide.
An Argent mason, associated by name with the Argent organization.
A disciple identified by association with Shadron.
Known as A’dal.
Known as M’ori.
K'uri is a dungeon creature.
Bridenbrad's spirit rises and casts Holy Nova before vanishing.
A Portal Keeper is a giant associated with guarding a portal. It can cast Arcane Missiles in combat.
A Putrid Colossus is an undead colossus, marked by its putrid condition.
A Flame Orb is an elemental in the form of a flame orb.
An Ebon Blade Champion is a humanoid champion bearing the Ebon Blade name.
An Argent Paladin is a humanoid paladin bearing the Argent name.
Bridenbrad Light Bunny is a small elemental associated with Bridenbrad.
Spitzpatrick's Bomber is a mechanical entity associated by name with Spitzpatrick.
An Unspiked Ghoul is an undead ghoul distinguished by being unspiked.
A Released Soul is a small elemental.
A champion of the Warsong, identified by that faction title.
A champion bearing the Valiance Expedition title.
A portal associated with Shadron.
A demon in a succubus transformation form; the label identifies a form rather than an individual.
A Dragonflayer Ironhelm, a humanoid.

Prince Keleseth is a San'layn prince associated with Utgarde. High Executor Anselm's account presents him as an enemy who insulted the queen and killed Anselm’s men, and calls for his defeat; those accusations are Anselm's framing of the conflict.
An Avenging Spirit, an undead creature.
An Avenging Spirit Summoner.
A Bladespire elder, whose title marks senior standing among the Bladespire.
A Bladespire guardian, bearing a title associated with protection.
The Bladespire Keg King, distinguished by a title linked to kegs.
A bloodthirsty tundra wolf, named for its habitat and aggressive nature.
A crystalfused miner, identified by its crystal-marked name and mining role.
A Dragonflayer Deathseeker, identified by its martial title.
A humanoid Dragonflayer fanatic.
A humanoid Dragonflayer seer.
A humanoid Dragonflayer spectator.
An ethereal smoke image.
A ferocious rhino, a beast.
A frenzied worgen beast.
Gan'arg Analyzer is a demon.
Gortok Palehoof is a named humanoid associated with the Palehoof boss encounter.
Grauf is a named dragonkin associated with the Skadi encounter.
An image of Arthas associated with the scene in which Svala Sorrowgrave is named and charged with destroying the uninvited guests.
A Jormungar Worm is a beast.
King Bjorn is a named king.
King Bjorn Visual is the visual portrayal bearing King Bjorn's name.
King Haldor is identified as a king.
A King Haldor Visual.
King Ranulf is identified as a king.
A King Ranulf Visual.
King Tor is a named figure bearing the designation King.
King Tor Visual is a named visual form.
Ymiron is an undead king.
Lakota Windsong is a named humanoid.
A mindless undead servant.
Mingo sells reagents and offers assistance, addressing exalted visitors as brothers or sisters.
A demonic mo’arg extractor.
Oacha'noa is the Goddess of the Depths, a named divine figure associated with the depths.
An ogre smoke image taking an ogre's form, rather than a named individual.
Ogri'la Keg King is a drink vendor whose banter calls cocktails and dreams the secret diet. The playful greeting gives this vendor a light touch while the role remains practical: offering drinks.
The Ogri'la Merchant supplies general goods and welcomes visitors as friends, inviting them to see what is available. The greeting gives this vendor a warm, straightforward manner.
An Ogri'la peacekeeper, this experienced guard is charged with maintaining the peace.

The Ogri'la Steelshaper treats metalwork as more than trade: steel draws strength from its wielder, and its value lies in the hand that shapes it. This vendor offers blacksmithing supplies and repairs.
An Ogri'la storyteller, identified by the role of sharing stories rather than by a personal name.
An Ogri'la trade-goods trader with a warm, familiar manner: they offer supplies, ask what the visitor seeks, and use greetings such as “friend” or “brother or sister.”
A dire bear marked as rabid, defined by its beast kind and feral condition.
A furbolg marked as ravenous, with its hunger as the defining trait.
An undead figure identified as a ritual channeler, a role centered on channeling during a rite.
A ritual target, designated by its role in a rite rather than a personal name.
Torki is a humanoid known by that name.
Torkus Jr. is a humanoid known by that name.
A Vortex Shardling is a giant creature. Its name identifies it as a shardling associated with the Vortex.
Ymirjar Berserkers are undead warriors identified by their berserker role.
Ymirjar Dusk Shamans are undead members of the Ymirjar identified by their shaman role.
A Ymirjar flesh hunter, identified by its flesh-hunting role.
A Ymirjar harpooner, identified by its harpooner role.
A Ymirjar necromancer, identified by its necromantic role.
A Ymirjar savage, identified by that title.
A Ymirjar warrior, identified by its warrior role.
A Ymirjar witch doctor, identified by its witch-doctor role.

An image of a Cult of the Damned shadow cultist serves as a messenger to his lady. He reports that the sleep-watchers in Jotunheim believe they have found someone significant, apparently a vrykul, though he has not seen the captive himself. His unfinished recollection reaches back to the Shadow Vault.

Vardmadra appears through an image to question a messenger about a vrykul reportedly found by the sleep-watchers in Jotunheim. She orders them to keep him asleep until she can judge him herself, presses for a name, and recognizes Iskalder as the greatest vrykul warrior. Her words show authority over the inquiry and knowledge of vrykul history.

Highlord Darion Mograine challenges a foe addressed as “King” to face the might of Mograine, declaring that the challenger faces death itself. He also addresses an ally with “Suffer well” and says he will see them back at the Valley of Echoes.

Jayde arrives with a cutting remark about someone being too weak to finish their own battles, then offers help. Before leaving, Jayde asks whether anything else is needed, opens a portal, and disappears. Jayde fights in the encounter, while the dialogue gives their aid a dry, faintly condescending edge.

Munch enters the fight with a boast, calls for Melt to arise, then declares the encounter over and leaves through a portal. Munch takes an active part in the battle, and the swaggering entrance followed by a blunt exit gives them a cocky, abrupt manner.
A Severed Soul, an undead.
Melt is a hostile creature.
An engineer in Wintergrasp.
A dragonkin Disciple of Vesperon.
A humanoid servant of Hodir.

Iskalder, called the Ancient Hero, is a mjordin sought in the Halls of the Ancestors. The Bone Witch's amulet is meant to be used on him to bring him back; the summoned Iskalder calls for it to be used quickly.
Subjugated Iskalder bears the title the Ancient Hero. When summoned, he follows the invoker.
A Twilight Whelp is a beast associated with the Twilight.
The Blessed Banner of the Crusade is planted as a rallying point. Its message calls on defenders to protect it from attackers.
A Portal Guardian is a beast that casts Azure Bindings in combat. Its name identifies its role as a guardian at a portal.
Portal Keeper is a dragonkin combatant associated with portal keeping. In combat, it casts Arcane Volley.
Lithe Stalker is a beast. When a passenger boards, it casts Force Scourge Reputation.

Marnak is a celestial archive intelligence that responds in clipped, technical language. It recounts how Loken ended the Aesir–Vanir conflict by neutralizing those who remained, then placed earthen, giants, and vrykul into stasis at designated facilities.

Kaddrak is an archive intelligence that speaks in clipped system language and shifts to countermeasures during a security breach. It explains that the Creators contained the Old God infection within its host after removal proved fatal, then instituted the Forge of Wills and other systems to create new earthen and appoint protectors.

Abedneum is an archival system with an aggressive security response. It halts processing when it cannot identify a life form, diverts void analysis during critical threats, and begins a memory purge after its fail-safes are deactivated.
Argent Mason is a mechanical worker with a masonry role.
Azure Inquisitor is an elite dragonkin combatant.
Azure Ley-Whelp is a dragonkin whelp.
An Azure Ring Guardian, a dragonkin.
An Azure Spellbinder, a dragonkin.
A magical centrifuge construct in the Oculus, one of the constructs whose destruction is needed to bring down Varos Cloudstrider’s shield and expose him.
A phantasmal air elemental can use Lightning Shield.
A Phantasmal Cloudscraper is a beast that can use Thunderclap and Chain Lightning.
Phantasmal Fire is an elemental that can cast Blaze in combat.
A phantasmal mammoth, a spectral beast in mammoth form.
A phantasmal murloc, a spectral humanoid creature.
A phantasmal naga, a spectral humanoid creature.
A phantasmal ogre, a spectral humanoid creature.
A phantasmal water elemental.
A phantasmal wolf, a spectral beast in wolf form.
A humanoid Ring-Lord Conjurer.
A Ring-Lord Sorceress, a humanoid.
Snowflake, an elemental.
A dragonkin Azure Binder.
An Argent battle-priest, this elite humanoid casts Blessing of Kings while out of combat.
